build: release, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, opt-level=3, LTO, one codegen unit

profile.path: two disposable namespaces connected by a veth pair, MTU 1500; no daemon or tunnel
profile.note: Four distinct physical cores on the same socket. No own builds or other tests ran during measurements.

units.goodput: unique UDP payload bytes divided by corresponding sender elapsed time
units.loss: 1 - receiver unique / sender sent; requires zero invalid and too_old
units.cpu: process CPU time divided by sender elapsed time, including receiver drain

scalar_trial.description: early-exit per-byte payload validation; replaced after capacity probe

vector_trial.description: branchless payload-validation reduction; temporary bench target

final.description: same validated data path under examples/udp_load.rs
